summary: V4-07 criterion not implemented. The candidate checkout is identical to the pristine accepted tree (no source code changes). V4-07 requires extending the backend frugal V3 to categories, named members, invitations, notes/photos, and todo-expense with delta-only sync, no full scans, privacy protection, lazy photos, deterministic conflicts, tenant isolation, and extended cost gates. Critical gaps: categories and invitations are missing from SYNC_COLLECTIONS (won't sync), no cost budgets for category/todo-expense operations, no pagination for several collections, and no sync tests for new collections. Trusted verification passed (all existing tests green) but V4-07 work has not been done.

findings.problem: SyncCollection type and SYNC_COLLECTIONS array missing 'categories' and 'invitations' collections. These V4-01/V3-06 entities will not participate in delta-only sync, violating V4-07 requirement 'delta-only préservé' and 'sync aux catégories, membres nommés, invitations'.
findings.evidence: SyncCollection type defines 8 collections: contribution_entries, expense_entries, settlements, todo_items, persistent_tasks, members, memberships, households. Categories and invitations are absent. syncEngine.ts iterates SYNC_COLLECTIONS for pull/push, so these collections are never synced.
findings.requiredFix: Add 'categories' and 'invitations' to SyncCollection type and SYNC_COLLECTIONS array. Ensure repositories implement SyncStateRepository.applyDeltas/materialization for these collections. Add sync tests for categories and invitations.
findings.verification: Sync tests pass for categories and invitations; pullDeltas/pushDeltas materialize category and invitation records; cost budget 'sync-delta' updated to reflect 10 collections.

findings.problem: COST_BUDGETS missing budgets for category operations (create-category, update-category, delete-category) and todo-expense operations (create-todo-expense, complete-todo-expense). V4-07 requires 'cost gate étendu'.
findings.evidence: COST_BUDGETS defines 7 budgets: open-household, tab-switch, create-contribution, complete-todo, sync-delta, create-invitation, accept-invitation. No budgets for category CRUD or todo-expense completion.
findings.requiredFix: Add cost budgets for: create-category (writes: 1), update-category (writes: 1), delete-category (writes: 1), create-todo-expense (writes: 1), complete-todo-expense (writes: 2: todo update + expense create). Update sync-delta budget reads/writes from 8 to 10 collections.
findings.verification: Cost gate tests pass with new budgets; costTracker.assertBudget enforces them; cost-gates-v3-08.test.ts extended with category and todo-expense budget tests.

findings.problem: Missing pagination (getByHouseholdPaginated) for CategoryRepository, MemberRepository, InvitationRepository, PersistentTaskRepository, TodoRepository. V4-07 requires 'aucun N+1/full scan' and 'historique paginé'.
findings.evidence: Only ContributionEntryRepository, ExpenseEntryRepository, SettlementRepository have getByHouseholdPaginated. Categories, members, invitations, persistent_tasks, todos only have getByHousehold returning all items.
findings.requiredFix: Add getByHouseholdPaginated to CategoryRepository, MemberRepository, InvitationRepository, PersistentTaskRepository, TodoRepository interfaces and implement in both InMemory and SQLite adapters. Use same cursor pattern (occurredAt DESC, id DESC) as existing paginated repos.
findings.verification: Pagination tests pass for all repositories; cost gate 'open-household' reads remain ≤5 with paginated access; no full scans on large collections.

findings.problem: sync-delta cost budget assumes 8 collections but will be 10 after adding categories and invitations. Budget must be updated to reflect actual collection count.
findings.evidence: COST_BUDGETS['sync-delta'] = { reads: 8, writes: 8, networkCalls: 2 } with comment '8 collections × pull + push'. SYNC_COLLECTIONS currently has 8 items; adding categories and invitations makes 10.
findings.requiredFix: Update sync-delta budget to { reads: 10, writes: 10, networkCalls: 2 } after adding categories and invitations to SYNC_COLLECTIONS.
findings.verification: Cost gate test 'sync-delta budget limits reads to ≤8' updated to ≤10 and passes.

findings.problem: No sync tests for categories and invitations collections. V4-07 requires 'conflicts déterministes' and 'tenant isolation' verified for all synced collections.
findings.evidence: v3-06-sync-e2e.test.ts tests pull/push for contribution_entries and expense_entries only. v3-06-groups-invitations-sync.test.ts tests invitation lifecycle but not sync engine integration.
findings.requiredFix: Add sync E2E tests for categories and invitations: remote delta materializes into business repo, local write produces dirty record, push sends to remote, conflict resolution, cross-tenant isolation.
findings.verification: New sync tests pass; categories and invitations behave identically to contributions/expenses in sync pipeline.

findings.problem: Cost gate tests don't cover category operations or todo-expense operations. V4-07 requires 'cost gate étendu'.
findings.evidence: cost-gates-v3-08.test.ts has 10 gates covering open-household, tab-switch, sync-delta, create-contribution, create-expense, classification cache, privacy gate, cost budgets, offline, golden path, accessibility. No gates for category CRUD or todo-expense.
findings.requiredFix: Add cost gate tests: Gate 11 - category create/update/delete are bounded writes (1 each, independent of history); Gate 12 - todo-expense create/complete are bounded writes; Gate 13 - sync-delta with 10 collections stays within budget.
findings.verification: Extended cost gate tests pass; all new budgets enforced by costTracker.assertBudget.

findings.problem: Privacy pipeline correctly rejects notes, categoryLabelSnapshot, and attachments (validateNoFreeText, validateNoAttachmentPayload). This satisfies V4-07 'notes/photos exclus analytics' and 'analytics sans texte/note/photo/IDs'. No fix needed.
findings.evidence: pipeline.ts lines 174-197: validateNoFreeText rejects 'note', 'categoryLabelSnapshot'; validateNoAttachmentPayload rejects 'attachments', 'attachmentRefs', 'photoRefs'. Privacy gate tests pass.
findings.verification: Privacy gate tests pass; no free text or attachment payloads in analytics output.

findings.problem: SQLite repositories for categories, invitations, members, persistent_tasks, todos lack pagination implementation. InMemory repositories also lack pagination for these collections.
findings.evidence: SqliteCategoryRepository, SqliteMemberRepository, SqliteInvitationRepository, SqlitePersistentTaskRepository, SqliteTodoRepository only implement getByHousehold, not getByHouseholdPaginated.
findings.requiredFix: Implement getByHouseholdPaginated in all five SQLite repositories with proper SQL LIMIT/OFFSET or cursor-based pagination. Mirror InMemory implementation pattern.
findings.verification: Pagination tests pass for both InMemory and SQLite adapters; paginated queries return correct cursor and hasMore.
